subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued supporters, We are excited to invite you to our Annual Charity Gala on December 15th at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an elegant evening of dinner, entertainment, and fundraising for a great cause. Your presence will make a difference in the lives of many. Please RSVP by November 30th to secure your seat. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, Charity Foundation
